description: UK personal-finance dates and thresholds for tax years 2025/26 and 2026/27: Self Assessment deadlines, ISA allowance, personal allowance and income tax bands (England, Wales and Northern Ireland, and Scotland separately), Class 1 and Class 4 NIC, VAT registration and deregistration, student loan repayment thresholds (Plans 1, 2, 4 and 5, plus postgraduate), Making Tax Digital for Income Tax, and trading and property allowances. Each item in the items array has id, label, value or threshold with units, effective_from, effective_to where known, tax_year, and a source_url to the GOV.UK page that states it, plus last_verified. Existing summary fields are unchanged.
name: get_uk_money_dates
title: UK money dates and thresholds 2025/26 and 2026/27
